scene: The opened breaker box powers up transit chutes and depot gates across town.
picture: Flat side-view along the workshop's opened back bay. The player stands beside the open breaker box. On the far left waits a yellow mail train in an open tube hatch. In the centre idle a courier on a teal motorbike with empty sidecar. On the right, a brass night funicular sits at its dock.
